args.query: Distance between finitely supported functions in WithLp one equals sum distances

items.name: PiLp.nndist_eq_of_L1
items.type:
∀ {ι : Type u_2} {β : ι → Type u_4} [inst : Fintype ι] [inst_1 : (i : ι) → SeminormedAddCommGroup (β i)]
  (x y : PiLp 1 β), nndist x y = ∑ i, nndist (x.ofLp i) (y.ofLp i)

items.name: PiLp.dist_toLp_single_same
items.type:
∀ (p : ENNReal) {ι : Type u_2} (β : ι → Type u_4) [hp : Fact (1 ≤ p)] [inst : Fintype ι]
  [inst_1 : (i : ι) → SeminormedAddCommGroup (β i)] [inst_2 : DecidableEq ι] (i : ι) (b₁ b₂ : β i),
  dist (WithLp.toLp p (Pi.single i b₁)) (WithLp.toLp p (Pi.single i b₂)) = dist b₁ b₂

items.name: WithLp.prod_edist_eq_of_L1
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_2} {β : Type u_3} [inst : SeminormedAddCommGroup α] [inst_1 : SeminormedAddCommGroup β]
  (x y : WithLp 1 (α × β)), edist x y = edist x.fst y.fst + edist x.snd y.snd

items.name: MeasureTheory.Lp.dist_eq_norm
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {E : Type u_4} {m : MeasurableSpace α} {p : ENNReal} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure α}
  [inst : NormedAddCommGroup E] (f g : ↥(MeasureTheory.Lp E p μ)), dist f g = ‖f - g‖
